item.title: Would You Trust AI To Manage Your Money?
item.description: OpenAI's Finances in ChatGPT puts a real-time financial analyst in your pocket. But between hallucinations, hidden fees, and zero fiduciary duty, is AI ready to manage your money?

item.title: The Solutions to Quantum Hacking & The Economics Behind PQC
item.description: As quantum computers threaten encryption, a $20 billion market is emerging to protect global infrastructure. Learn who profits from the quantum security transition, and why smaller banks may face elimination.

item.title: Quantum Hacking & Banking Security
item.description: Quantum computers threaten to break modern encryption, and the global banking system faces a critical vulnerability. Discover how Post-Quantum Cryptography is racing against the clock to secure trillions in financial assets.

item.title: Being an Influencer in 2026: Sustainable Career or Saturated Market?
item.description: An analysis of market growth, income inequality, and the psychological toll of the creator economy.

item.title: Quantum Computing & The Future Economy
item.description: From drug discovery to cryptography, quantum technology is projected to generate $100 billion in economic value by the mid-2030s. But what is quantum computing, and what is it used for?

item.title: Why Clean Energy Makes Sense, Economically
item.description: In 2024, 528 gigawatts of renewable energy were added to the global energy system, preventing $57 billion in fossil fuel usage while boosting economic growth and job creation.

item.title: Tokenomics: Explained
item.description: Why so some cryptocurrencies hold long-term while others fade away? A close look at the tokenomics of the project can explain how supply, demand, and incentives shape these outcomes.

item.title: Discover Our Mission
item.description: Future Economists is a student-created journal dedicated to researching how and why emerging technologies will reshape the global economic landscape.
